fieldValues.title: An agent's words reach a page only when the writer swaps them in
fieldValues.move: Agents may draft any copy for a page, but only as alternatives in the page's drafts, each derived from the block it would replace. The writer sees every alternative beside the block and swaps one in, and a swapped-in block stays marked as the agent's until the writer edits it. The page records who wrote each block, so drafting help never arrives unseen.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Whether the words are true, which is the evidence remedy (856afe73). Essays, where the affirmed writer persona wants no agent drafting at all (SP-58 for essays stays answered by d1e2248f).
fieldValues.falsifier: After the homepage has been rewritten with agent drafts available, the owner finds a block on the page whose author they cannot tell from the page, or agent copy reached the page without the owner swapping it in.
fieldValues.return_when: When the homepage has been rewritten in the site editor and the owner has said whether agent drafts helped or pulled them away from writing.
